title: Q-RES-ashby-1952-A4: A search that stops before anything holds (measured 0.0, target >= 0.25)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: ashby-1952 finding A4 is not-met (measured 0.0)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe ashby-1952:A4
**Prediction:** second_loop_kept_share >= 0.25 within 336 h
**Status:** closed

Concern: A search that stops before anything holds. The study: The ultrastable system keeps changing its step-functions until it reaches a configuration that holds the essential variables within limits, and then keeps it. A loop that gives up after a fixed list of tries, or never finds a configuration that holds, has not adapted.

Mechanisms that should answer it: ASHBY-SEARCH-1 (foundation/ultrastability.py); ULTRASTABILITY-1 (foundation/ultrastability.py).

Metric: share of second-order steps that brought the variable back inside its limits and were kept, target >= 0.25. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 8.4 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
